description: This file defines several shared React UI components related to user experience (UX), including skeleton loaders, empty state displays, and filter bars. It exports components such as SkeletonBlock, SkeletonText, EmptyState, and FilterBar, which can be used throughout the frontend application to maintain consistent UX patterns.

methods.name: SkeletonBlock({ style, className = "" })
methods.description: A generic rectangular skeleton shimmer block used as a loading indicator.

methods.name: SkeletonText({ lines = 2, lineHeight = 10 })
methods.description: A multi-line text skeleton component that renders animated blocks to simulate loading text.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title, description, primaryAction, secondaryAction })
methods.description: Displays a friendly empty state message with optional actions for when there's no data to show.

methods.name: FilterBar({ title = "Filters", left, right, mobileDrawerContent,  onReset, onApply, applyLabel = "Apply", resetLabel = "Reset", })
methods.description: A container component for filter controls, including left and right sections and reset/apply actions.

ctags.name: EmptyState
ctags.pattern: /^export function EmptyState({ title, description, primaryAction, secondaryAction }) {$/

ctags.name: FilterBar
ctags.signature: ({ title = "Filters", left, right, mobileDrawerContent,  onReset, onApply, applyLabel = "Apply", resetLabel = "Reset", })
